execute_iterable: run a worker that executes an iterable in a subprocess or subinterpreter with command and data queues
wait_for_init: wait for a subprocess or subinterpreter worker to finish initialization with a timeout
enter_iteration_mode: instruct a worker to stop any ongoing iteration and start a new one with acknowledgement
iterate_results: watch a data queue and yield results from a subprocess or subinterpreter worker iteration
drain_queue: drain all items from a multiprocessing or subinterpreter queue until it is empty
